labels.reason: Focuses on bariatric surgery and medical management for T2D remission; lifestyle intervention is not the study focus.

Evaluates pioglitazone for NASH rather than lifestyle interventions for diabetes management.
Evaluates a pharmacological T2D treatment; prior diet and exercise guidance are enrollment background rather than study interventions.
Studies protein supplementation in night-shift workers and explicitly excludes participants with diabetes.
Evaluates a T2D drug combination; previous diet and exercise are background treatment rather than interventions being studied.
Investigates pharmacological blood pressure management, without exercise, dietary, or behavioral intervention.

Studies genetic diabetes risk in individuals without diabetes, without a lifestyle intervention.
